name: The Super Snapper FX
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Have the first look at my new invention, adventurer. All you need to do is target whatever it is you'd like to take a picture of, and push the button.

What was that creature from the Hinterlands that you mentioned? Gammerita? Well, good luck finding her. I'm sure Daryn will be quite pleased with the snapshot you return to her.

In any case, here's the Super Snapper. Have fun!
narrative.objectives: Use the Super Snapper FX to take a snapshot of Gammerita, then return to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well! Curgle's invention lived up to its expectations.

Don't get too excited, but do know that I am pleased with your work, adventurer.

Now, where did I leave that book...
narrative.requestItemsText: So, you have finally returned, adventurer. And you've brought the contraption that Curgle built for me -- perfect.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 47 to 50, 19,040 XP in all.

quests.name: In Search of Knowledge
quests.objectiveText: Talk to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.

quests.name: Feralas: A History
quests.objectiveText: Ask Daryn Lightwind if you may borrow her book.

quests.name: The Borrower
quests.objectiveText: Take the letter to Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Super Snapper FX
quests.objectiveText: Use the Super Snapper FX to take a snapshot of Gammerita, then return to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.

quests.name: Return to Troyas
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the book to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Stave of Equinex
quests.objectiveText: Energize Troyas' Stave and find the Equinex Monolith.

quests.name: The Morrow Stone
quests.objectiveText: Return the Sparkling Stone and the Stave of Equinex to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.
